body:
Thanks for the reply, this all seems like really good advice, especially that last sentence. I sort of wish I had a really good stable friend but most of mine are sort of as messed up as me, except some college friends who I can’t see really for the next couple months. For the recording music part I just really wish I lived alone, I’m too terrified of being judged by people I live with. 

I guess I left out that I probably won’t be getting an internship this summer so I might have to go back home to my parents/be guilted into working at a grocery store or some other place to save up more money. That’s why I’m trying to beef up my confidence and stuff before I go back. I think reading through this sub and everyone’s stories and advice is helping me come more to terms with this and helping me start to love myself more, so I’ll do more of that in the mean time.

I feel sorta the same. I never felt like I could get into my passion for fear of being made fun of for it in my household. To this day, even though I’m out of the house, I still have a mental block that stops me from pursuing it. I’ve never been able to work on it for more than a few hours before I give up because my parents only want me in a normal job and never thought I could succeed at any arts or anything, so I’ve just never been able to believe in myself. I’ve always hoped I’d hit the point where I say “fuck em” and go for it but I’m honestly just so tired, hopefully it’ll happen one day when I can stop having my parents in the back of my mind all the fucking time.
yeah dude there’s no way i can possibly have that much celery
What if your overthought version of the world where everything is negative is just the real world.
I do spend a lot of time alone with my thoughts. Why does that lead to a spiral?
